about: What each wheel's 75100 is set to in VESC Tool for the robot. Values with a 'sources' entry are read from that file and checked by tools/check-hardware.py; the rest are hand settings from the docs named in 'from'. Change the source, never only this copy.

from.can: docs/body-firmware.md 4.2: status 1 at 500 Hz, 4/5 at 50 Hz, the app's CAN timeout 0.1 s (the wheels freewheel when the MCU stops talking)
from.limits.firmware_current_max_a: the firmware clamps its command to this; docs/body-firmware.md 4.2 also asks for motor and battery limits of 25 A in VESC Tool
from.limits.motor_current_max_a: D69: 30 A motor maximum, 10 A continuous
from.limits.battery_current_max_a: docs/body-electrical.md W14: 20 A in VESC Tool (the fuse board's FL1 holders carry 22 A)
from.motor: docs/wheel-change-plan.md W6: FOC, halls, 15 pole pairs, regen -15 A, ERPM 15,000; the phase filter note is catalog/motor_drivers.json's

open: battery current: 20 A (wiring table) or 25 A (firmware section); B13 settles it
the regen limit is matched to the firmware's GP_REGEN_I_A at B13
